The engine's frame: x along the house, left to right standing in the yard facing the house (south at x = 0, north on the right — asbuilt x mirrored, x = 615" - x_asbuilt); y out from the house. The job-local fields (fascia posts, glass, vertical cable, ties, braces as built, (V) items, notes) are read by jobs/messner_site/tooling/messner_ext.py; the engine ignores them.

client: Adam Messner and Allison Rhodes Messner, Trustees of The 2017 Messner Family Trust

2025 California Wildland-Urban Interface Code (CWUIC), Part 7, Ch. 5, as amended by MCC 19.04.064

site.wui_listing: SFM 8110-2042:0001 (Class A) and 8170-2042:0504 cover the 5.5" board; ICC-ES / CCRR-0101: joists 16" o.c. max.

zones.name: B
zones.label: North strip — the stair leaves its north end

framing.knee_brace_bolts: end connections not visible — per the engineer of record (2018 detail: 5/8" x 10" lag each end + LTP4 each side)
beam_notes: B1 (inner, ~87" from the house): the house-side joists hang from a continuous header on it (LUS-type hangers, A35 / LTP4-type clips header to beam)
B2 (outer, ~172" from the house): the joists bear on top, Simpson H2.5A at each joist
framing.footing_words: Existing round concrete piers ~12-14" dia., 4-12" above grade, cast-in post bases (CBSQ66-type); 2018 design: 12" Quik-Tube pier on a 15" sq x 12" spread footing, 36" min. into competent bearing, (4) #4 vert + #3 ties — size and depth as built to be verified (V)

railing.fascia_fastening: bracket to the rim: (2) galvanized hex lags + washers per flange (4 per bracket) through the PVC fascia into the rim, as seen; an engineered connection on wood (ESR-4217 covers the bracket into concrete only)
railing.glass_note: Infill: fully tempered safety glass, [1/4"] nominal min., CPSC 16 CFR 1201 Cat. II, each panel permanently marked (CRC R324.1) — confirm the etched mark (V); glazing in a guard is a hazardous location (CRC R324.4.4); the panels are infill, the posts and top rail carry the guard load

extras.as_built_note: Dimensions, members and hardware are from the owner's sketches, 27 site photos (26 Oct 2026) and the 2018 design (M. Tepperman); values marked (V) are to be field-verified by the owner before the final submittal. The sheets record the deck as it stands.
